about_short_description.short_description: Gather is a video chat platform designed to make virtual interactions more human.

product.name: Gather Virtual Office Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables users to create and use customizable virtual spaces for video chat and collaboration, simulating in-person office interactions.

product.name: Gather Mapmaker and Build Tools
product.description: Tools within the platform that allow users to design and customize virtual office layouts and spaces to fit their team’s needs.

identifier.value: Gather Meetings and Video Collaboration Features

product.name: Gather Meetings and Video Collaboration Features
product.description: Integrated video chat and meeting capabilities within virtual spaces, supporting screen sharing, annotations, and real-time collaboration.

product.name: Security and Access Control Features
product.description: Mechanisms to manage user access, privacy, and security within virtual spaces, including password protection, single sign-on, and guest management.

product.name: Integrations with Productivity Tools
product.description: Integration capabilities with external services such as Slack, Google Calendar, and Outlook to streamline scheduling and communication.
